llm_generated_explanation.summary: Your genetic result affects how well you respond to clopidogrel. People with this result are at increased risk for the drug not working as intended, which can lead to serious cardiac and cerebrovascular events.
llm_generated_explanation.mechanism: Clopidogrel is a prodrug that needs to be converted into an active form by an enzyme. Your genetic result affects how well this enzyme works, which in turn affects how well the drug works. If the enzyme doesn't work well, less of the active form is produced, and the drug may not work as intended.
